reason: I always forget my pills at home or leave the bottle behind when I travel, so pre-counted sachets I can toss in my gym bag actually fit my life. The named lab and the batch report make me trust it more than a random TikTok brand, and $24.99 for the first box is fine to try.
objection: Two capsules every day is still a chore, and I will probably skip it on days I am out and forget the sachet in my bag. Also it is made in China, and I only have the brand's word that the report is real.
